arknights_list_vue.response: normalized Arknights listing rows from goods-list-big Vue state
arknights_list_vue.notes: The Arknights route is gameId 84 and catalogue 6. The rendered Vue component exposes goodsList and loadMore; the adapter loads additional batches before applying local price filters. No browser credential is persisted.

arknights_detail_nuxt.response: one normalized Arknights account-detail row from detailsData and metadataModel.resources
arknights_detail_nuxt.notes: detailsData provides price, description, onStandTime, verifyTime and verification method; metadataModel.resources plus the visible .scroll-item_box asset grid provide operator/skin names, elite corner marks, resource ids and image URLs. Merge both because load timing can expose one before the other. onStandTime and verifyTime remain separate.

zzz_detail_dom.response: one normalized account-detail row from rendered Nuxt DOM
zzz_detail_dom.notes: Page exposes Nuxt-rendered detail state and visible asset DOM. WAF cookies may be required, but no cookie value is stored here. Use the browser-backed COOKIE adapter.
